subject: C14
performed_by: Claude Code driving the real fixture window through macOS Accessibility (tools/native-acceptance/ax.swift, System Events keystrokes); tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c14.py

checks.description: The API Client destination opens a v1 collection through the folder sheet (fixture: the staged folder) and lists its requests by method and path, its folders and its problems (an invalid request file is reported, not shown); opening a request shows its method, URL, params, headers, body and auth/variables under accessible names.
checks.observation: open {'opened': True, 'listed': True, 'problem': True, 'bad_hidden': True, 'fields': {'Method': True, 'URL': True, 'Params': True, 'Headers': True, 'Body': True, 'Auth and variables (TOML)': True}, 'url': 'https://api.example.com/items', 'complete_after_fix': True}

checks.description: Typing a new URL and pressing Cmd+S at once (inside the protection debounce) writes exactly the typed snapshot to the request file, keeping its comment, trailing comment and extension key; the status says Saved.
An invalid header row is refused with 'Fix to save' naming Headers and the row; the request file is unchanged and the editor keeps what was typed.

An edit protected by a typing pause survives quitting and relaunching: reopening the collection from Recent restores the request as a recovered draft with the typed text; Discard draft returns to the saved version.

Close guard: quitting right after typing (before protection) shows the native sheet 'Quit with unprotected API Client edits?'; Cancel keeps the app and the text; once protected, Cmd+Q quits without the sheet.
checks.observation: close guard {'sheet': True, 'asked': True, 'cancel_kept_app': True, 'text_kept': True, 'protected_quit': True}

checks.description: A request changed on disk after it was opened is not overwritten: Save reports Changed on disk; Keep mine rebases the edits and the next Save writes them; Use disk on another conflict shows the disk version.
checks.observation: keep mine {'reported': True, 'untouched': True, 'rebased': True, 'written': True}; use disk {'reported': True, 'used': True, 'disk_shown': True, 'file_unchanged': True, 'kept_privately': True, 'archives': [1, 2]}

checks.description: A workbench secret value is entered in a secure field and stored in the Keychain: the Secrets list says 'value stored', the preview masks it, and the value appears in no accessibility snapshot or private/project file; tenant.* references are shown as tenant-managed with no field.
checks.observation: secrets {'listed': True, 'stored': True, 'managed': True, 'masked': True, 'missing_line': False}; value in AX snapshots: []; in files: []

checks.description: A pasted cURL command with credentials becomes an unsaved draft with secret references and a conversion report (no file until Save); a staged Insomnia v5 export previews its resources, refuses a scripted request, creates the selected ones as drafts and leaves the export file unchanged.
checks.observation: cURL {'report': True, 'no_file': True, 'no_secret': True}; Insomnia {'previewed': True, 'refused_script': True, 'created': True, 'source_unchanged': True}

checks.description: Open Strata Cloud Manager writes the built-in collection privately and opens its 193 generic request specifications; an OAuth request's preview names tenant-managed references and nothing is sent.
checks.observation: built-in {'opened': True, 'request': 'Open GET Management/AuthService/Retrieve OAuth 2.0 claims (GET).request.toml', 'oauth': True, 'nothing_missing': True, 'private': True}

checks.description: Offline and no replay (T23): no request reaches any network endpoint during API Client work, and after relaunch no save is repeated (project files are byte-identical to before the relaunch).
checks.observation: network requests 0; files changed by relaunch: False

checks.description: Keyboard and accessibility: the tools tab list, navigator, open-request tabs (method, name and unsaved/conflict marks in their names) and editor fields are reachable by Tab; Save stays reachable and clear of the bottom fade at 200% zoom and at the minimum window size.
checks.observation: Tab reached {'tools': True, 'find': True, 'tab': True, 'url': True, 'save': True}; 200% zoom: {'label': 'Save', 'pos': [607, 617], 'size': [174, 88]}; minimum size: {'label': 'Save', 'pos': [363, 516], 'size': [87, 45]}

checks.description: The Git view reads the collection's repository read-only (branch and changed files) and runs no repository-configured program (a core.fsmonitor script leaves no marker).
Profile adoption previews the staged v1 API Client profile, imports the selected collection into Recent with its private environment, never changes the source files and transfers no secret value.
checks.observation: adoption {'listed': True, 'candidate': 'Items API (api) · 1 private environments', 'recent': True, 'source_unchanged': True}; v1 unchanged: True

limitations: The fixture build answers the collection folder sheets and the Insomnia file sheet with staged paths; the production rfd sheets are the same adapters' native branch (flag fixture-native-sheets) and are not driven here.
Interrupted saves are exercised by the workbench_documents suite (a fixture fault between file writes and a restart); the window is not killed mid-write here.
Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names and focus are inspected.
